calculate_full_flops: calculate the total FLOPs for a transformer model given dataset size, hidden size, num heads, and num layers
calculate_model_params: calculate the total number of parameters for a transformer model given hidden size, num heads, and num layers
calculate_simple_flops: estimate training FLOPs using the simple 2x params times dataset size formula for a transformer model
get_dataset_size_from_flops: compute the required dataset size in tokens given a target FLOP count and transformer model architecture
refactor_flops_calculation: refactor the full_flops function to support additional attention mechanisms or custom layer configurations
